items.t: Head gasket and cam seal leaks on the 2.4L
items.job: Replace head gasket (with updated gasket) and cam seals
items.note: Machining a warped cylinder head adds cost.

items.t: Automatic transmission shifts erratically or drops out of gear
items.job: Diagnose and repair transmission controls or rebuild the transmission
items.note: Control or sensor repairs are at the low end; a rebuild is at the high end. CarComplaints lists a typical cost of about $1,500.

items.t: Engine stalls while driving or when slowing down
items.note: Owners who guessed at other parts first spent $800 or more.

items.t: Spark plug tube seals leak oil and cause misfires on the 2.4L
items.job: Replace spark plug tube seals and fouled plugs

items.t: Oil pressure light flickers at idle from a bad sender
items.note: CarComplaints lists a typical cost of about $20.

items.t: EGR valve or passage clogs on the 2.5L V6
items.job: Clean the EGR pipe and replace the EGR valve and transducer
items.note: CarComplaints lists a typical cost of about $130. Tight access adds labor.

items.t: Blower fan only works on high or not at all
items.note: If the fan switch is also bad, add the cost of the switch assembly.

items.t: Power steering hose can leak and catch fire (recall 06V-001)
items.job: Recall replacement of the power steering pressure hose
items.note: Free at a Chrysler dealer if not already done. Check your VIN on nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Cylinder head oil plug can leak and start a fire (recall 96V-006)
items.job: Recall repair of the engine oil plug
items.note: Free at a Chrysler dealer if not already done. Check your VIN on nhtsa.gov/recalls.
